title: Google Satellite Embedding V1 Annual
description: Annual, global 10 m embedding fields produced by Google and Google DeepMind with AlphaEarth Foundations. Each pixel holds a unit-length 64-dimensional vector summarising a calendar year of multi-source Earth observation (optical, SAR, LiDAR, climate, elevation). Suited to classification, regression and change detection with few labels and no inference.

review: Year coverage differs by host: the Earth Engine catalog lists 2017-2024, the GCS readme 2017-2025, the Source Cooperative mirror 2018-2024 (2017 withheld for a quality issue).

emb:quantization_method: signed square: float = sign(q) * (q / 127.5)^2, q in [-127, 127], -128 = nodata (COG copies on GCS and Source Cooperative; Earth Engine serves values in [-1, 1])
processing:lineage: Embeddings from all observations in a calendar year, in local UTM projection; tiles of about 163,840 m (8192 x 8192 px) with 64 bands A00-A63. Dataset version 1.1 (2025-11-17) regenerated 2017 with more Sentinel-1 acquisitions.
regions_coverage: Global (land and shallow waters, incl. intertidal, reefs, inland and coastal waterways)
temporal_coverage_note: One layer per calendar year from 2017, extended yearly. Polar coverage limited by orbits; minor swath and data availability artifacts remain.

gcs.title: COGs on Google Cloud Storage (provider pays)

access_requirements: Earth Engine account for the catalog; COGs open on Source Cooperative S3 (no account) and on GCS (provider pays)
